---
title: "Publications"
---


```{python}
#| echo: false

import json
from IPython.display import display, Markdown

with open("data/publications.json") as f:
    pubs = json.load(f)

for p in pubs:
    title = p.get("title", "")
    year = p.get("year", "")
    doi = p.get("doi", "")

    if doi:
        link = f"https://doi.org/{doi}"
        publication = f"[DOI]({link})"
    else:
        publication = ""

    display(Markdown(
        f"""
<div class="publication">

**{title}**

{year} · {publication}

</div>

---
"""
))
```
